abstract: Presenting pesticide dosages in range formats (e.g., 10–40 g) is presumed to offer farmers flexibility to adjust dosage application based on pest or disease pressure, and thereby facilitating precise use. However, this conventional practice may unintentionally encourage pesticide overuse. Based on a lab‐in‐the‐field experiment, this study finds that approximately 65% of farmers disregard the minimum dosage when exposed to range‐based labels, anchoring instead on the upper bound. A nudge‐based label design, featuring reference points and brief explanatory cues, can significantly reduce pesticide use without restricting farmers' autonomy. These findings reveal both the hidden risks and promising potential of label‐based interventions, suggesting that thoughtfully designed labels can serve as a low‐cost, scalable policy tool for mitigating excessive chemical use problem in agriculture.
abstract_zh: 以范围形式呈现农药剂量（如10–40克）被认为能为农户提供灵活性，使其根据病虫害压力调整施药量，从而促进精准用药。然而，这一常规做法可能无意中助长农药过度使用。基于一项田间实验室实验，本研究发现约65%的农户在面对范围标签时会忽略最低剂量，反而以上限为锚定标准。一种基于助推设计的标签方案，通过设置参考点并辅以简要解释性提示，能在不限制农户自主权的前提下显著减少农药使用量。这些发现揭示了标签干预措施既存在潜在风险，也蕴含巨大潜力，表明精心设计的标签可作为低成本、可推广的政策工具，用于缓解农业中化学品过度使用问题。

abstract: This paper introduces a novel method to adaptively design randomized experiments. For randomized experiments with a pilot stage, or multistage experiments, Hahn et al. (2011) propose an adaptive experimental design that adjusts the next stage's propensity score based on data from the previous stages. This paper discusses how the discretization of covariates affects the precision of the estimation of the average treatment effect (ATE) through the estimated propensity score for the next stage. Also, this paper proposes an algorithm using the bootstrap technique to find the optimal level of discretization of covariates. Monte Carlo simulations and an application with actual data show that the suggested method performs well.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种自适应设计随机实验的新方法。针对包含预实验阶段或多阶段随机实验，Hahn等人（2011）提出了一种自适应实验设计，该设计基于前一阶段的数据调整下一阶段的倾向得分。本文探讨了协变量离散化如何通过下一阶段估计的倾向得分影响平均处理效应（ATE）估计的精度。同时，本文提出了一种基于自助法（bootstrap）技术的算法，用于确定协变量的最优离散化水平。蒙特卡洛模拟及实际数据应用表明，所建议的方法表现良好。
title: Optimal Covariate Discretization in Adaptive Randomized Experiments
title_zh: 自适应随机实验中的最优协变量离散化

abstract: We study the asset allocation and investment performance of U.S. private foundations that support the charitable sector. Large foundations generated positive risk‐adjusted returns before 2008, driven by early access to private equity and venture capital funds, but have underperformed since. The median foundation underperforms by more than 100 bps. Foundations with concentrated stock holdings achieve higher returns but assume more risk. Due to the constraints imposed by the 5% minimum spending rule and accommodating monetary policy, foundations increase risk‐taking and reach for yield. Over time, a conservative asset allocation decreases real wealth, reducing charitable giving.
abstract_zh: 本文研究美国私人基金会在支持慈善事业中的资产配置与投资绩效。大型基金会在2008年前通过早期进入私募股权和风险投资基金获得了正向风险调整收益，但此后表现不佳。中位数基金会业绩落后超过100个基点。持有集中股票的基金会获得更高收益，但承担更多风险。受5%最低支出规则约束及宽松货币政策影响，基金会增加风险承担并追逐收益。长期来看，保守型资产配置会减少实际财富，进而降低慈善捐赠。
title: Investing with Purpose: Evidence from Private Foundations
title_zh: 有目的的投资：来自私人基金会的证据

abstract: We examine whether providing free school meals to all students causes changes in out‐of‐school suspensions for schools adopting those policies in the United States. Using updated data and modern difference‐in‐differences methods that account for staggered adoption, we show suspensions fall by approximately 10% in elementary schools and 6% in middle and high schools, with larger effects in schools that previously served fewer students eligible for free and reduced‐price meals in preadoption periods. These findings contrast with earlier null results, primarily due to better methods that account for staggered program adoption as opposed to the updated dataset.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国实施免费校餐政策后，该政策是否导致学校校外停学处分的变化。采用更新后的数据及考虑交错采纳的现代双重差分方法，我们发现小学停学率下降约10%，初中和高中下降约6%，且在政策实施前享受免费或减价餐食资格学生较少的学校中效果更为显著。这些发现与早期零结果形成对比，主要归因于采用更优方法处理交错采纳效应，而非数据更新本身。
title: Universal free meals and school suspensions
title_zh: 全民免费校餐与停学处分

abstract: This paper introduces the concept of participatory persuasion in autocracies, where regimes use controlled communication to sustain their rule. In an overlapping-generations model of democratization, we show that the regime’s survival can be prolonged when citizens communicate within small circles compared to a setting in which communication is entirely absent. Paradoxically, limited freedom of speech enhances the regime’s persuasion by turning citizens into inadvertent agents of state propaganda. We further extend the analysis to settings with homophily or under state censorship.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了威权政体中“参与式说服”的概念，即政权通过受控沟通来维持其统治。在一个代际交叠的民主化模型中，我们证明，与完全没有沟通的环境相比，当公民在小圈子内交流时，政权的存续时间可以得到延长。矛盾的是，有限的言论自由通过将公民转变为国家宣传的无意代理人，增强了政权的说服力。我们进一步将分析扩展到同质性或国家审查制度下的情境。
title: A model of participatory persuasion
title_zh: 参与式说服模型

abstract: This paper examines effort-maximizing move orders in two-player Tullock contests across varying levels of contest accuracy and player asymmetries. Unlike prior work that favors strong-lead sequential formats in lottery contests, our analysis demonstrates that all three formats—strong-lead, weak-lead, and simultaneous—can be optimal in the general Tullock contests. Strong-lead contests are most effective in noisy environments, but lose their advantage as contest accuracy increases. Weak-lead contests may become optimal when the weaker player successfully preempts. Simultaneous-move contests tend to perform better as the players’ ability differences become less severe. Overall, the optimal contest design jointly depends on the contest accuracy levels and relative strengths of the contestants.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在两人Tullock竞赛中，随着竞赛精确度与选手不对称性的变化，何种移动顺序能最大化努力程度。与先前偏好于彩票竞赛中强者领先顺序格式的研究不同，我们的分析表明，在一般Tullock竞赛中，三种格式——强者领先、弱者领先及同时进行——均可能成为最优选择。在噪声环境中，强者领先竞赛最为有效，但随着竞赛精确度的提升，其优势逐渐减弱。当较弱选手成功抢占先机时，弱者领先竞赛可能成为最优。而随着选手能力差异减小，同时移动竞赛往往表现更佳。总体而言，最优竞赛设计取决于竞赛精确度水平及参赛者相对实力的共同作用。
title: The effort-maximizing move order in tullock contests
title_zh: 塔洛克竞赛中努力最大化的行动顺序

abstract: In many observational studies in social science and medicine, subjects or units are connected, and one unit’s treatment and attributes may affect another’s treatment and outcome, violating the stable unit treatment value assumption (SUTVA) and resulting in interference. To enable feasible estimation and inference, many previous works assume exchangeability of interfering units (neighbors). However, in many applications with distinctive units, interference is heterogeneous and needs to b e modeled explicitly. In this paper, we focus on the partial interference setting, and only restrict units to be exchangeable conditional on observable characteristics. Under this framework, we propose generalized augmented inverse propensity weighted (AIPW) estimators for general causal estimands that include heterogeneous direct and spillover effects. We show that they are semiparametric efficient and robust to heterogeneous interference as well as model misspecifications. We apply our methods to the Add Health dataset to study the direct effects of alcohol consumption on academic performance and the spillover effects of parental incarceration on adolescent well-being.
title: Semiparametric Estimation of Treatment Effects in Observational Studies with Heterogeneous Partial Interference

abstract: Pigouvian taxes are often unpopular among the general public. We test the effectiveness of pro-tax social information in increasing support for such taxes. In a lab experiment that involves a market game with externalities, we provide subjects with information about other participants’ views about the “right thing to do” (voting, or not, for the tax policy). We also elicit personal, normative, and positive beliefs. Our findings demonstrate a causal effect of social information provision on subjects’ support for the tax, and that subjects’ changes in beliefs is a causal mechanism through which this increased support for the tax is made possible. We therefore highlight the important role of beliefs in voting behaviors and the acceptability of Pigouvian taxes.
abstract_zh: 庇古税在公众中往往不受欢迎。我们通过实验检验了支持税收的社会信息在提升此类税收支持度方面的有效性。在一个涉及外部性的市场博弈实验室实验中，我们向受试者提供了关于其他参与者对“正确做法”（即是否投票支持税收政策）看法的信息。同时，我们也收集了个人信念、规范性信念和实证性信念。研究结果显示，社会信息的提供对受试者支持税收产生了因果效应，并且受试者信念的变化是实现这一税收支持度提升的因果机制。因此，我们强调了信念在投票行为及庇古税可接受性中的重要作用。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Harnessing Social Information to Improve Public Support for Pigouvian Taxes
title_zh: 利用社会信息提升公众对庇古税的支持

abstract: We examine the timing of timber harvesting, when neighboring forest stands interact through windthrow risk. Positive adjacency externality stems from the sheltering effect of tall trees whereas negative externality stems from a windthrow-prone border created by clear felling or wind damage. We model wind damages as catastrophic, which call for immediate salvage harvest and regeneration. We augment previous optimal rotation results by extending the analysis to a dynamic harvest policy, where harvest age depends on the age of the neighboring stand. We examine both an efficient equilibrium and an inefficient noncooperative Markov perfect equilibrium. In the efficient equilibrium, where the externality is internalized, harvest is delayed when the neighboring stand is mature. This delay provides shelter by postponing harvest-created border risks. In the noncooperative equilibrium, the shelter is not provided, yet the harvest age adapts to increased risk-levels due to the border effect. We numerically test the magnitude of the border effect under various model assumptions and find that pricing the carbon externality makes the harvest policy more responsive to the adjacency externality.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了相邻林分因风倒风险相互作用时，木材采伐时机的选择问题。正向邻接外部性源于高大树木的庇护效应，而负向外部性则源于皆伐或风灾造成的易风倒边界。我们将风灾建模为灾难性事件，要求立即进行救伐和更新。通过将分析扩展至动态采伐政策（其中采伐林龄取决于相邻林分的林龄），我们完善了以往的最优轮伐期研究。我们同时考察了有效均衡和低效的非合作马尔可夫完美均衡。在外部性内部化的有效均衡中，当相邻林分成熟时，采伐会被推迟。这种延迟通过推迟采伐造成的边界风险来提供庇护。在非合作均衡中，庇护效应缺失，但采伐林龄会因边界效应导致的风险水平上升而调整。我们通过数值模拟检验了不同模型假设下边界效应的规模，发现对碳外部性定价会使采伐政策对邻接外部性更加敏感。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Adjacency Externality and the Timing of Timber Harvesting – The Case of Windthrow Risk
title_zh: 邻接外部性与木材采伐时机——以风倒风险为例

abstract: We examine how reminders for self-set goals influence productivity by analyzing data from 10,187 volunteer agricultural extension workers in Rwanda. We elicited workers’ goals and experimentally varied their salience through text reminders. Due to unforeseen logistical delays, approximately half of the treatment group received reminders after completing their tasks. We find that goal reminders received during the regular working period increased a productivity index by 0.08 standard deviations, while reminders sent late had no effect. Further analysis of heterogeneity by goal ambition quartiles reveals an inverted U-shaped relationship: reminders are effective for goals in the second and third quartiles, but ineffective for low or excessively high goals. These results suggest that workers who set ambitious yet realistic goals are more likely to respond to reminders and increase productivity, consistent with prior evidence on externally set goals.
abstract_zh: 我们通过分析卢旺达10，187名农业推广志愿者的数据，探讨了针对自我设定目标的提醒如何影响生产力。我们引导工人设定目标，并通过短信提醒实验性地改变其显著性。由于不可预见的后勤延误，约半数的治疗组在完成任务后才收到提醒。我们发现，在正常工作期间收到的目标提醒使生产力指数提高了0.08个标准差，而延迟发送的提醒则无效果。进一步按目标雄心四分位数进行的异质性分析揭示了倒U型关系：提醒对第二和第三四分位数的目标有效，但对低目标或过高目标无效。这些结果表明，设定雄心勃勃且现实目标的工人更可能对提醒作出反应并提高生产力，这与先前关于外部设定目标的证据一致。
title: The effect of reminders for self-set goals on productivity
title_zh: 自我设定目标的提醒对生产率的影响

abstract: We examine the informativeness of fund risk disclosure by combining fund returns and textual data. We develop a novel measure, INF, to capture the explanatory power of disclosed risks for fund returns. Average INF is 55% after controlling for market risk and remains 26–29% after excluding risks related to fund name or strategy. We explain variations in INF through disclosure costs and benefits: (1) Funds with less informative disclosures face SEC comment letters and reduced flow, (2) informative disclosures attract institutional flows, and (3) performance concerns may disincentivize disclosure. Overall, funds face trade-offs between transparency and maintaining their competitive advantage. (JEL G12)
abstract_zh: 我们通过结合基金收益与文本数据，考察了基金风险披露的信息含量。我们构建了一个新颖的指标INF，用以衡量已披露风险对基金收益的解释力。在控制市场风险后，平均INF为55%；在剔除与基金名称或策略相关的风险后，该指标仍保持在26%至29%之间。我们通过披露成本与收益来解释INF的差异：（1）信息披露含量较低的基金会收到美国证券交易委员会的意见函，并面临资金流入减少；（2）信息含量高的披露能吸引机构资金流入；（3）业绩担忧可能抑制披露意愿。总体而言，基金在透明度与维持竞争优势之间面临权衡。（JEL G12）
title: Do Mutual Funds Walk the Talk? Evidence from Fund Risk Disclosure
title_zh: 共同基金是否言行一致？来自基金风险披露的证据

abstract: This paper examines gender differences in pension literacy in Italy, distinguishing between knowledge of the public pension pillar and knowledge of supplementary pensions. Using a cross-sectional survey of 2436 working-age adults, we document a substantial raw gender gap in pension literacy. Once observable differences between men and women are taken into account, these characteristics explain roughly half of the gap, while the remaining half persists even after conditioning on observables. Our findings further show that the gender gap is not uniform across pension domains. Women remain significantly less informed about the public pension system, whereas the gap disappears in the case of supplementary pensions. These results suggest that women’s lower pension literacy reflects not only broader differences in financial literacy, but also a specific disadvantage in understanding the public pension system.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了意大利养老金素养中的性别差异，区分了对公共养老金支柱的了解与对补充养老金的了解。利用一项涵盖2436名劳动年龄成年人的横截面调查，我们记录了养老金素养中显著的原始性别差距。在考虑男女性别间的可观测差异后，这些特征解释了约一半的差距，而剩余一半即使在控制可观测变量后依然存在。我们的研究结果进一步表明，性别差距在养老金领域并非均匀分布。女性对公共养老金体系的了解显著较少，而在补充养老金方面，这一差距则消失。这些结果表明，女性较低的养老金素养不仅反映了金融素养方面的广泛差异，也体现了其在理解公共养老金体系上的特定劣势。
title: Gender gap in pension literacy: Evidence from Italy
title_zh: 意大利养老金素养的性别差距：来自意大利的证据

abstract: This paper studies electoral competition over redistributive taxation between a safe incumbent and a risky opponent. With reference-dependent preferences, economically disappointed voters become risk lovers, and hence are attracted by the more risky candidate. We show that the equilibrium can display policy divergence: the intrinsically more risky candidate proposes lower taxes and is supported by a coalition of very rich and very disappointed voters, while the safe candidate proposes higher taxes. This can explain why right-wing populist parties are often supported by economically dissatisfied voters and yet they run on policy platforms of low redistribution.
abstract_zh: 本文研究安全在任者与风险挑战者之间围绕再分配税收的选举竞争。在参照依赖偏好下，经济上失望的选民会变成风险偏好者，因而更倾向于支持风险较高的候选人。我们证明，均衡状态可能呈现政策分化：内在风险较高的候选人提出较低税率，并得到由极富裕和极失望选民组成的联盟支持，而安全候选人则提出较高税率。这可以解释为何右翼民粹主义政党常获得经济不满选民的支持，却推行低再分配的政策纲领。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: The Political Implications of Reference-Dependent Preferences,
title_zh: 参考依赖偏好的政治含义

abstract: We study how job mobility, firms, and firm-ladder climbing can shape immigrants’ labor market success. Our context is the mass migration of former Soviet Union Jews to Israel during the 1990s. Once in Israel, these immigrants faced none of the legal barriers that are typically posed by migration regulations around the world, offering a unique backdrop to study undistorted immigrants’ job mobility and resulting unconstrained assimilation. Rich administrative data allows us to follow immigrants for up to three decades after arrival. Immigrants experienced large initial wage gaps relative to natives—57% for men and 47% for women—and 12%–20% of these gaps are explained by differential sorting across firms and differential pay-setting within firms. The wage gap closes only after 27–29 years, and much of this convergence is driven by immigrants’ differential climbing of the firm ladder: immigrants are more mobile and experience faster upward moves, even in the long term. As such, firm-to-firm mobility is a key driver of these immigrants’ long-run prosperity. Lastly, we quantify a previously undocumented job utility gap when accounting for non-wage amenities. Upon arrival, immigrants’ non-pay amenities were lower by 0.38 (men) and 0.94 (women) native standard deviations. As such, amenities exacerbate immigrant-native disparities based on pay alone.
abstract_zh: 本文研究职业流动性、企业以及企业阶梯攀升如何影响移民在劳动力市场中的成功。我们的研究背景是20世纪90年代前苏联犹太人向以色列的大规模移民。抵达以色列后，这些移民未面临全球移民法规通常设置的法律障碍，这为研究不受扭曲的移民职业流动性及其导致的无约束同化提供了独特背景。丰富的行政数据使我们能够追踪移民抵达后长达三十年的情况。移民最初面临相对于本地人的巨大工资差距——男性为57%，女性为47%——其中12%至20%的差距可由企业在不同群体间的差异化配置以及企业内部差异化薪酬设定解释。工资差距需27至29年才能弥合，而这一趋同过程很大程度上源于移民在企业阶梯上的差异化攀升：移民流动性更强，且即使在长期内也能实现更快的向上流动。因此，企业间流动性是这些移民长期经济繁荣的关键驱动力。最后，我们在考虑非工资福利后，量化了此前未被记录的职位效用差距。抵达时，移民的非薪酬福利比本地人低0.38（男性）和0.94（女性）个标准差。因此，福利因素加剧了仅基于薪酬的移民与本地人之间的差距。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: The Role of Firms and Job Mobility in the Assimilation of Immigrants: Former Soviet Union Jews in Israel 1990–2019,
title_zh: 企业与工作流动性在移民融入中的作用：1990–2019年以色列的前苏联犹太人

abstract: This article combines personnel records of the U.S. government with census data to study how exposure to greater female representation at work can persistently reduce intergenerational gender gaps in labour market outcomes. Exploiting city-by-department variation in the sudden expansion of female employment during World War I, we find that daughters of civil servants exposed to female co-workers are more likely to work later in life. This intergenerational effect operates through exposed fathers and extends beyond the public sector, reducing the earnings gap by 12%. Consistent with a broader shift in attitudes towards working women, exposure to female co-workers also made male civil servants more likely to marry working women. We show that cities exposed to larger increases in female federal workers saw persistently higher female labour force participation in both the public and the private sector. Increasing gender representation within the public sector can thus have broader labour market implications.
abstract_zh: 本文结合美国政府人事档案与人口普查数据，研究工作中女性代表性提升如何持续缩小劳动力市场结果的代际性别差距。利用第一次世界大战期间女性就业突然扩张的城市-部门差异，我们发现，接触过女性同事的公务员的女儿在日后更有可能进入职场。这种代际效应通过受影响的父亲发挥作用，并延伸至公共部门之外，使收入差距缩小12%。与对职业女性态度整体转变相一致的是，接触女性同事也使男性公务员更有可能与职业女性结婚。研究表明，接触女性联邦雇员数量增长更大的城市，其公共与私营部门的女性劳动参与率均持续提高。因此，提升公共部门内的性别代表性可能对更广泛的劳动力市场产生深远影响。
title: Closing Gender Gaps Through Workplace Diversity: The Intergenerational Effects of World War I
title_zh: 通过职场多样性缩小性别差距：第一次世界大战的代际效应

abstract: Location games capture important economic phenomena ranging from preemption to choice of bank leverage. We explore a parametric family of location games with many players, each facing a conflict between maximizing a fundamental payoff component and a relative (or quantile dependent) component. Using simulations and human subject experiments we show that, behaviorally, the stationary Nash equilibria in such games are terrible predictions of behavior and payoffs when players can freely adjust their locations. Instead, large cycles consistently emerge, in which behavior slowly grows bolder over time. This corresponds to progressively earlier timing in pre-emption games or to increasingly later timing in wars of attrition. When locations are maximally bold, namely at the end of the domain of Nash play, behavior quickly reverts to the peak fundamental and a new cycle begins.
abstract_zh: 区位博弈捕捉了从抢占先机到银行杠杆选择等一系列重要经济现象。我们探讨了一个包含众多参与者的参数化区位博弈家族，其中每个参与者都面临在最大化基本面收益成分与相对（或分位数依赖）成分之间的冲突。通过模拟实验和人类受试者实验，我们表明，在行为层面，此类博弈中的静态纳什均衡在参与者能够自由调整其位置时，对行为和收益的预测能力极差。相反，大规模循环持续出现，其中行为随时间逐渐变得更加大胆。这对应于抢占博弈中时机逐渐提前，或消耗战中时机逐渐延后。当位置达到最大胆程度，即处于纳什博弈域的末端时，行为迅速回归至基本面峰值，新一轮循环随即开始。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: Cyclical behavior in large location games
title_zh: 大型区位博弈中的周期性行为

abstract: Global warming is having increasingly negative health effects, particularly in relatively poor and hot countries such as India. These impacts are partly due to the direct effect of high temperatures on the human body, and partly due to vector-borne diseases and reduced food availability. While numerous harmful health effects of high temperatures have been established, there is very little research into their possible impact on anemia, a medical condition affecting 25% of the global population and 43 % of people in India. Using health, nutrition and climate data, we analyze the relationship between heat exposure and anemia in India over the past decade. We match blood hemoglobin measurements from nearly 265,000 children, 914,000 women and 140,000 men to two different measurements of exposure to heat, based on air temperature and wet-bulb globe temperature respectively. We find that heat exposure in the 30 days preceding blood measurement is associated with anemia in these three population groups. Moreover, the mechanisms responsible do not seem to be related to nutritional deficiencies, while direct effects and malaria could explain part of the relationship between temperature and anemia. Finally, we estimate the number of extra anemia cases induced by a + 2 ∘ C increase in air temperature, which has an associated cost of around 4.2 billion US dollars, i.e., 0.11 % of Indian GDP.
abstract_zh: 全球变暖正对健康产生日益严重的负面影响，尤其是在印度这样相对贫困且炎热的国家。这些影响部分源于高温对人体的直接作用，部分则归因于媒介传播疾病和粮食供应减少。尽管高温的诸多有害健康效应已被证实，但关于其对贫血——一种影响全球25%人口及印度43%人口的医学状况——可能产生的影响，研究却寥寥无几。利用健康、营养和气候数据，我们分析了过去十年间印度热暴露与贫血之间的关系。我们将近265,000名儿童、914,000名女性和140,000名男性的血液血红蛋白测量数据，分别与基于气温和湿球黑球温度的两种不同热暴露测量指标进行匹配。研究发现，在血液测量前30天内的热暴露与这三个人群中的贫血状况相关联。此外，其作用机制似乎与营养缺乏无关，而直接影响和疟疾可能部分解释了温度与贫血之间的关联。最后，我们估算了气温升高+2°C所导致的额外贫血病例数量，其相关成本约为42亿美元，相当于印度GDP的0.11%。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: A hidden health impact of heat: exacerbated anemia in India
title_zh: 热浪的隐性健康影响：印度贫血症的加剧

abstract: Climate-related disasters can affect housing markets by making previously underappreciated risks more salient. This paper studies how a rare and catastrophic quick-clay landslide in Eastern Norway affects housing market outcomes. The event constituted a double information shock for the housing market: extensive national media coverage sharply increased public attention to quick-clay risk, while the same coverage widely disseminated interactive hazard maps and encouraged people to assess whether their own properties were located in at-risk zones. Using detailed property transaction data from Eastern Norway, we combine a two-way fixed effects difference-in-differences design with boundary-based comparisons of properties located near mapped hazard zones. Properties exposed to quick-clay risk experience statistically significant price declines of 1–1.5 percent relative to non-exposed properties, with effects extending beyond the directly affected municipality. Event-study estimates show that the response is temporary, reflecting a short-lived adjustment in risk perceptions. Applying these event-study estimates to exposed properties sold in Eastern Norway during the two-year response period implies a capitalization loss of approximately USD 23 million. We find little indication of effects on transaction volumes, but new residential development in quick-clay risk zones appears to fall by roughly 12 percent. Overall, the findings show that even a highly visible fatal disaster generates a detectable but limited and short-lived housing market response.
abstract_zh: 气候相关灾害可能通过使先前未被充分认识的风险变得更加显著而影响住房市场。本文研究挪威东部一次罕见且灾难性的快黏土滑坡如何影响住房市场结果。该事件对住房市场构成了双重信息冲击：全国性媒体的广泛报道急剧提升了公众对快黏土风险的关注，同时这些报道广泛传播了交互式灾害地图，并鼓励人们评估自己的房产是否位于风险区域内。利用挪威东部的详细房产交易数据，我们将双向固定效应双重差分设计与基于边界的地块比较相结合，比较位于已绘制灾害区域附近的地块。暴露于快黏土风险的房产相对于未暴露房产，价格出现统计上显著的1%至1.5%的下降，且影响延伸至直接受灾市镇之外。事件研究估计显示，这一反应是暂时的，反映了风险认知中的短期调整。将这些事件研究估计应用于挪威东部两年响应期内出售的暴露房产，意味着资本化损失约为2300万美元。我们发现对交易量影响的迹象甚微，但快黏土风险区域内的新建住宅开发似乎下降了约12%。总体而言，研究结果表明，即使是一场高度可见的致命灾害，也只会引发可检测但有限且短暂的住房市场反应。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: When climate risks become evident: A natural experiment on risk perceptions in the housing market
title_zh: 气候风险显现时：住房市场风险认知的自然实验

abstract: This article analyzes the link between business cycles synchronization and trade integration using panel data for 15 West African countries from 2000 to 2020. Business cycles synchronization is a key requirement from the standpoint of establishing a common currency by 2027. We add to the body of literature by considering intra-industry trade and accounting for the effect of fiscal, monetary and exchange rate policies. Our results suggest that trade intensity is positively related to the synchronization of business cycles in West Africa. However, intra-industry trade is not the major factor explaining the co-movements of the business cycles. Indeed, our findings indicate that the enhancement of fiscal, monetary, and exchange rate coordination fosters the synchronization of business cycles. The study’s results have relevant policy implications for the proposed formation of a West African currency union.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2000年至2020年15个西非国家的面板数据，分析了商业周期同步性与贸易一体化之间的联系。商业周期同步性是到2027年建立共同货币的关键要求。我们通过考虑产业内贸易并纳入财政、货币及汇率政策的影响，为现有文献做出了贡献。研究结果表明，在西非，贸易强度与商业周期同步性呈正相关。然而，产业内贸易并非解释商业周期共同变动的主要因素。实际上，我们的发现表明，加强财政、货币及汇率政策的协调有助于促进商业周期的同步性。该研究结果对拟议中的西非货币联盟形成具有重要的政策启示。
title: The impact of trade integration on the business cycles synchronization in West African Countries: Implications for the AfCFTA
title_zh: 贸易一体化对西非国家经济周期同步性的影响：对非洲大陆自由贸易区的启示

abstract: We provide the first systematic evidence on the short-run labor market consequences of the 25% decline in Canadian visits to the United States in 2025. We combine smartphone foot-traffic data measuring Canadian visitor presence at the ZIP code × industry level with real-time establishment-level employment records. Exploiting the high heterogeneity in exposure to Canadian visits, we find that small establishments in the top 1% exposed local-industry markets experienced employment declines of about 6% compared to less exposed ones. Our estimates imply between 13,900 and 42,100 jobs lost, concentrated in a small number of localities.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于2025年加拿大赴美访问量下降25%对短期劳动力市场影响的首个系统性证据。我们将衡量加拿大游客在邮政编码×行业层面存在的智能手机人流数据，与实时企业层面的就业记录相结合。利用加拿大访问暴露度的高度异质性，我们发现，在暴露度最高的1%本地行业市场中，小型企业的就业相比暴露度较低的企业下降了约6%。我们的估计表明，约有13,900至42,100个工作岗位流失，且集中在少数地区。
title: When neighbors stop knocking: The impact of Canada’s 2025 tourism decline on U.S. local labor markets
title_zh: 当邻居不再敲门：加拿大2025年旅游业下滑对美国地方劳动力市场的影响

abstract: This paper articulates and, using newly-assembled data, explores how international taxation affects aggregate tangible cross-border investment. Spillovers from statutory tax rates abroad seem: As sizable as effects from the host’s rate; larger than previous consensus values (attributed to a systematic bias from FDI data); and consistent with ‘implicit’ profit shifting through real investment (rather than ‘paper’ profit shifting). Contrary to much policy discussion, the results also imply that: Host countries’ marginal effective tax rates have at best a weak effect on real investment; those elsewhere have none; and, applied to the prospective global minimum tax, inward tangible investment in most sample countries will increase.
abstract_zh: 本文阐述并利用新汇编的数据，探讨国际税收如何影响总体有形跨境投资。来自国外的法定税率溢出效应似乎：与东道国税率的影响一样大；大于先前共识值（归因于FDI数据的系统性偏差）；并与通过实际投资进行的“隐性”利润转移（而非“纸面”利润转移）相一致。与许多政策讨论相反，结果还表明：东道国的边际有效税率对实际投资的影响至多微弱；其他地方的税率则无影响；并且，应用于拟议的全球最低税时，大多数样本国家的内向有形投资将会增加。
title: International tax spillovers and tangible investment, with implications for a global minimum tax
title_zh: 国际税收溢出效应与有形投资：对全球最低税的影响

abstract: This paper examines the enduring effects of early-life exposure to heatwaves on the climate governance of local political leaders. We compile detailed biographical information on city mayors and party secretaries in China and combine it with comprehensive data on carbon emissions, economic outcomes, and policies for over 2800 counties from 2000 to 2017. We find that counties governed by officials who experienced heatwaves in their early life exhibit about a 1% reduction in carbon emissions relative to those governed by officials without such exposure. The effect is driven primarily by mayors, officials with more intense or repeated heatwave exposure, and cities with less industrialized economic structures. Further analysis provides suggestive evidence that these officials are more likely to implement carbon pricing and emission abatement policies, as well as policies with clear targets, enforcement, and mandatory language. Their governance reshapes local economic structures by constraining the activity and entry of emission-intensive manufacturing firms, a pattern further supported by firm-level evidence of lower carbon emissions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了早期生活中经历热浪对地方政治领导人气候治理的持久影响。我们汇编了中国城市市长及市委书记的详细传记信息，并将其与2000年至2017年间超过2800个县的碳排放、经济成果及政策综合数据相结合。研究发现，由早期生活中经历过热浪的官员治理的县，其碳排放量相较于未经历此类暴露的官员所治理的县，约减少1%。这一效应主要由市长、经历更强烈或更频繁热浪暴露的官员，以及工业化程度较低的经济结构的城市所驱动。进一步分析提供了提示性证据，表明这些官员更可能实施碳定价和减排政策，以及具有明确目标、执行机制和强制性语言的政策。他们的治理通过限制排放密集型制造业企业的活动和进入，重塑了地方经济结构，这一模式也得到了企业层面碳排放降低的证据支持。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: The enduring impacts of early life exposure to heatwaves on climate governance
title_zh: 早期热浪暴露对气候治理的持久影响

abstract: This paper develops a competitive search model with asymmetric information and argues that small firms hold liquid assets not only to self-finance their investments but also to signal their investment quality, thereby obtaining better loan terms. Because self-finance is an outside option of borrowing, it affects bank loans and the credit market structure. Monetary policy affects the cost of self-finance and hence affects the market structure and the screening regimes in the credit market. An increase in the policy rate can trigger banks to use screening contracts, which distort allocations. Using U.S. data, I document that dispersion in firms’ cash-to-asset ratios is hump-shaped in policy rates, consistent with the model’s prediction that firms use liquidity holdings to signal.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含信息不对称的竞争性搜索模型，并论证小企业持有流动资产不仅是为了自我融资其投资，也是为了传递其投资质量的信号，从而获得更优的贷款条件。由于自我融资是借款的外部选择，它影响银行贷款和信贷市场结构。货币政策影响自我融资的成本，进而影响信贷市场的市场结构和筛选机制。政策利率的上升可能促使银行采用筛选合同，这会扭曲资源配置。利用美国数据，我记录了企业现金资产比率的离散度在政策利率上呈驼峰形分布，这与模型预测的企业利用流动性持有进行信号传递相一致。
title: Adverse selection and small business finances
title_zh: 逆向选择与小企业融资

abstract: How important are social norms, information gaps and family constraints in explaining the low rates of female labor force participation (FLFP) in conservative societies? To answer this question, we conducted a field experiment embedded in a survey of female university students at a large public university in Saudi Arabia. We randomly provided one subset of individuals with information on the labor market and aspirations of their female peers (T1), while another subset was provided with this information along with a prime that made their parents more salient (T2). We find that expectations of working among those in the Control group are quite high, yet students underestimate the expected labor force attachment of their female peers. We show that social information matters: relative to the Control group, expectations about own labor force participation are significantly higher in the T1 group, which is driven primarily by receiving information about their peers' aspirations. We show that T2, as intended, causes students to report a higher importance of parents' approval of their choices. However, we do not find that the impact of information is counteracted by evoking parental expectations: impacts for the T2 group on labor market expectations are not smaller than those for T1 group. However, T2 does lead to higher expectations of working in Education and the Public sectors -sectors that are more socially acceptable for women, suggesting that parental expectations their daughters' labor market aspirations but partly shape them.
abstract_zh: 社会规范、信息差距和家庭约束在解释保守社会中女性劳动力参与率（FLFP）偏低方面有多重要？为回答这一问题，我们在沙特阿拉伯一所大型公立大学对女大学生进行了一项嵌入调查的实地实验。我们随机向一组受试者提供了关于其女性同龄人在劳动力市场和 aspirations 方面的信息（T1），而另一组则在此基础上额外获得了一种提示，使她们父母的重要性更加凸显（T2）。我们发现，对照组中对工作的期望相当高，但学生们低估了其女性同龄人的预期劳动力参与度。我们证明，社会信息具有重要性：与对照组相比，T1组中对自身劳动力参与度的期望显著更高，这主要源于接收到关于同龄人 aspirations 的信息。我们表明，T2 按预期导致学生报告父母对其选择认可的重要性更高。然而，我们并未发现信息的影响因唤起父母期望而被抵消：T2组对劳动力市场期望的影响并不小于T1组。但T2确实导致了对教育和公共部门工作期望的更高值——这些部门对女性而言更具社会接受度，这表明父母的期望并未削弱女儿的劳动力市场 aspirations，但在一定程度上塑造了它们。
title: Information and Social Norms: Experimental Evidence on the Labor Market Aspirations of Saudi Women
title_zh: 信息与社会规范：沙特女性劳动力市场抱负的实验证据

abstract: We consider auctions with N “weak-valued” bidders and an 𝑁 + 1 -th bidder who is “strong.” The auction is a “tournament” in which the weaker players bid to win the right to compete with the strong bidder. The sealed bids of all players are binding and the winning bid of the weaker players is entered in a second-price contest with the bid of the strong player. As we already noted in Anderlini and Kim (2024a), the tournament design of the auction generates “overbidding” by the weaker bidders. This is due to the fact that the only way for a weak bidder to win the auction is to win among the weak bidders. We let the values of the strong bidder converge in distribution to an atom above the upper end of the distribution of the weak bidders. If the rest of the distribution is drained away from low values sufficiently slowly, the auction’s expected revenue is arbitrarily close to the one obtained in a Myerson (1981) optimal auction. The auction design is “detail free” — no specific knowledge of the distributions is needed in addition to the identity of the stronger bidder. No information about the actual value of the limit large atom is required. This is important since mis-calibrating by a small amount an attempt to implement the optimal auction can lead to large losses in revenue.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个包含N个“弱价值”竞标者以及一个第N+1位“强”竞标者的拍卖场景。此拍卖采用“锦标赛”形式，其中较弱的参与者竞标以争取与强竞标者竞争的权利。所有参与者的密封投标均具有约束力，而较弱参与者的获胜出价将与强竞标者的出价一同进入第二价格竞赛。正如我们在Anderlini和Kim（2024a）中已指出的，这种锦标赛式拍卖设计会导致较弱竞标者出现“过度出价”现象。这源于弱竞标者赢得拍卖的唯一途径是在弱竞标者群体中胜出。我们让强竞标者的价值在分布上收敛于一个原子，该原子位于弱竞标者价值分布的上端之上。如果分布其余部分从低价值端以足够缓慢的速度被抽离，拍卖的预期收益将任意接近Myerson（1981）最优拍卖所获得的收益。该拍卖设计是“无需细节”的——除了强竞标者的身份外，无需对分布有具体了解，也无需知晓极限大原子的实际价值。这一点至关重要，因为试图实施最优拍卖时，即使校准偏差微小，也可能导致收益大幅损失。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Tournament auctions with a strong limit bidder
title_zh: 强限制竞拍者下的锦标赛拍卖
